name: 01-cover-drive.jpg
caption: Golden hour on Ocean Boulevard: chase-cam behind the Solaris GT under a layered tropical sunset (gold horizon, coral and magenta cloud bands, sun rays), a two-star patrol cruiser on its rear quarter, traffic both ways, strollers on both pavements, Art Deco hotels with neon marquees, Mission 02 on the objective card and the vector minimap with its scalloped beach.

name: 02-police-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star sunset pursuit: interceptors on the drifting supercar's bumper, skid marks and tyre smoke behind it, the police helicopter's searchlight pinning it, a V roadblock ahead, the neon Ferris wheel and the backlit far-shore skyline across the bay.

name: 03-on-foot-heist.jpg
caption: Mission 03 on foot: an over-the-shoulder SMG firefight at the Solaris Vault Bank Plaza, with its Art Deco colonnade, gold SOLARIS VAULT neon marquee, lit lobby glass, bollards and striped barricades. Armoured vault guards return fire. Star muzzle flashes, short gold tracers, brass casings and sparks off the muscle car used as cover.

name: 04-city-map.jpg
caption: The city menu (M): an organic coastal map of Solaris Bay with turquoise depth contours, the golden scalloped Sunset Beach, Coral Pier and its wheel, Starlight Key with marina slips on the causeway, colour-coded district zones, GPS route, and the story, activities and Safehouse Garage sidebars.
